mapper.sql: v.id, v.visitor_name, v.phone, v.id_card, v.visit_purpose, v.visit_object, v.visit_time, v.leave_time, v.status, v.counselor_id, v.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.real_name AS counselor_name FROM visitor_log v LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON v.counselor_id = u.id WHERE v.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visitor_log (visitor_name, phone, id_card, visit_purpose, visit_object, visit_time, leave_time, status, counselor_id) VALUES (#{visitorName}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{visitPurpose}, #{visitObject}, #{visitTime}, #{leaveTime}, #{status}, #{counselorId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM visitor_log WHERE status = #{status}
